        display_name = ore.split(":")[1].replace("_", " ").title()
        color = "green" if collected[ore] else "red"
        marker = "[✓]" if collected[ore] else "[ ]"
        result.append((f"{marker} {display_name}", color))
    return result

def format_duration(seconds):
    minutes = int(seconds // 60)
    seconds_part = int(seconds % 60)
    return f"{minutes:02d}:{seconds_part:02d}"

def send_tellraw(components):
    # Construct JSON message from components
    extra = []
    for text, color in components:
        extra.append({"text": text, "color": color})
        extra.append({"text": "\n"})
    if extra:
        extra.pop()  # Remove trailing newline
    
    message = {"text": "", "extra": extra}
    m.execute(f'tellraw @a {json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False)}')

def print_divider():
    m.execute('tellraw @a {"text":"----------","color":"gray"}')

def show_main_title(text, color="white"):
    m.execute(f'title @a title {{"text":"{text}","color":"{color}","bold":true}}')

def show_title_with_sub(title_text, sub_text, title_color="gold", sub_color="aqua"):
    m.execute(f'title @a title {{"text":"{title_text}","color":"{title_color}","bold":true}}')
    m.execute(f'title @a subtitle {{"text":"{sub_text}","color":"{sub_color}"}}')

def handle_chat_events():
    global collected, collection_timestamps, previous_inventory, last_status_report
    with m.EventQueue() as queue:
        queue.register_chat_listener()
        while True:
            event = queue.get()
            if event.type == m.EventType.CHAT:
                command = event.message.lower()
                current_time = time.time()
                
                if "reset" in command:
                    # Reset all state and restart
                    collected = {ore: False for ore in required_ores}
                    collection_timestamps = {}
                    m.execute(f"scoreboard objectives remove {scoreboard_objective}")
                    m.execute(f"bossbar remove {bossbar_identifier}")
                    begin_mining_session()
                    
                elif "status" in command:
                    # Throttle status updates
                    if current_time - last_status_report > STATUS_DELAY:
                        last_status_report = current_time
                        print_divider()
                        send_tellraw([
                            ("Current Mining Status:", "yellow"),
                            (f"Time Elapsed: {format_duration(current_time - session_start)}", "green"),
                        ] + generate_colored_ore_list())
                        print_divider()

def begin_mining_session():
    global session_start, previous_inventory
    
    print_divider()
    
    # Countdown before starting
    for count in ["3", "2", "1"]:
        show_main_title(count, "gold")
        time.sleep(1)
    
    show_main_title("Go!", "green")
    time.sleep(1)
    
    # Initialize game state
    initialize_scoreboard_and_bossbar()
    session_start = time.time()
    
    # Announce start
    print_divider()
    send_tellraw([
        ("Mining Session Started!", "yellow"),
        (f"Start Time: {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(session_start))}", "green"),
    ])
    print_divider()
    send_tellraw(generate_colored_ore_list())
    
    previous_inventory = capture_inventory_state()

def capture_inventory_state():
    inventory = m.player_inventory()
    return {item.item: item.count for item in inventory if item.count > 0}

def run_mining_loop():
    global previous_inventory
    
    while True:
        current_inventory = capture_inventory_state()
        
        for ore in required_ores:
            if not collected[ore]:
                prev_amount = previous_inventory.get(ore, 0)
                curr_amount = current_inventory.get(ore, 0)
                
                if curr_amount > prev_amount:
                    # Ore detected as collected
                    collected[ore] = True
                    now = time.time()
                    lap_time = now - session_start
                    collection_timestamps[ore] = lap_time
                    
                    # Update scoreboard
                    ore_key = ore.split(":")[1]
                    m.execute(f"scoreboard players set {ore_key} {scoreboard_objective} 0")
                    
                    # Refresh UI
                    refresh_actionbar_and_bossbar()
                    
                    # Notify player
                    print_divider()
                    show_title_with_sub("Item Collected!", ore_key.replace("_", " ").title())
                    send_tellraw([
                        (f"Acquired: {ore_key.replace('_', ' ').title()}", "aqua"),
                        (f"Lap Time: {format_duration(lap_time)}", "yellow"),
                    ] + generate_colored_ore_list())
                    
                    # Check completion
                    if all(collected.values()):
                        end_time = time.time()
                        total_duration = end_time - session_start
                        
                        print_divider()
                        show_main_title("Mission Complete!", "gold")
                        send_tellraw([
                            ("All ores successfully gathered!", "gold"),
                            (f"Total Duration: {format_duration(total_duration)}", "green"),
                        ])
                        
                        m.execute(f"bossbar set {bossbar_identifier} visible false")
                        print_divider()
        
        previous_inventory = current_inventory
        time.sleep(0.2)

# Launch background threads
Thread(target=handle_chat_events).start()
begin_mining_session()
run_mining_loop()

import torch
import warp as wp
wp.set_module_options({"enable_backward": False})
import newton
import newton.examples
import newton.utils
from newton import GeoType, State

# Reordering mappings for joint coordinate systems
LAB_TO_MUJOCO = [0, 6, 3, 9, 1, 7, 4, 10, 2, 8, 5, 11]
MUJOCO_TO_LAB = [0, 4, 8, 2, 6, 10, 1, 5, 9, 3, 7, 11]

@torch.jit.script
def invert_quat_rotation(q: torch.Tensor, vec: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Apply inverse rotation of quaternion q to vector vec."""
    w = q[..., 3]  # scalar part (w)
    v = q[..., :3]  # vector part (x, y, z)

    term1 = vec * (2.0 * w * w - 1.0).unsqueeze(-1)
    term2 = torch.cross(v, vec, dim=-1) * w.unsqueeze(-1) * 2.0

    if v.dim() == 2:
        dot_prod = torch.bmm(v.view(v.shape[0], 1, 3), vec.view(v.shape[0], 3, 1)).squeeze(-1)
        term3 = v * dot_prod * 2.0
    else:
        dot_prod = torch.einsum("...i,...i->...", v, vec)
        term3 = v * dot_prod.unsqueeze(-1) * 2.0

    return term1 - term2 + term3


def build_observation(
    actions,
    sim_state: State,
    base_joint_positions,
    device,
    reorder_idx,
    gravity_direction,
    motion_cmd,
):
    # Extract root orientation and velocities from simulation state
    root_orient = torch.tensor(sim_state.joint_q[3:7], device=device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
    root_lin_vel = torch.tensor(sim_state.joint_qd[:3], device=device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
    root_ang_vel = torch.tensor(sim_state.joint_qd[3:6], device=device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)

    # Joint positions and velocities relative to base
    current_joint_pos = torch.tensor(sim_state.joint_q[7:], device=device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
    current_joint_vel = torch.tensor(sim_state.joint_qd[6:], device=device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)

    # Transform velocities into body frame
    body_lin_vel = invert_quat_rotation(root_orient, root_lin_vel)
    body_ang_vel = invert_quat_rotation(root_orient, root_ang_vel)
    down_vec = invert_quat_rotation(root_orient, gravity_direction)

    # Compute deviations from initial joint configuration
    joint_deviation = current_joint_pos - base_joint_positions
    joint_rate = current_joint_vel.clone()

    # Reorder joints according to Mujoco convention
    reordered_pos = torch.index_select(joint_deviation, 1, reorder_idx)
    reordered_vel = torch.index_select(joint_rate, 1, reorder_idx)

    # Concatenate all observation components
    obs_parts = [
        body_lin_vel,
        body_ang_vel,
        down_vec,
        motion_cmd,
        reordered_pos,
        reordered_vel,
        actions,
    ]
    return torch.cat(obs_parts, dim=1)


class SimulationScenario:
    def __init__(self, visualizer, config_args):
        self.visualizer = visualizer
        self.device = wp.get_device()
        self.torch_backend = wp.device_to_torch(self.device)
        self.testing_mode = config_args is not None and getattr(config_args, "test", False)

        # Initialize model builder with custom solver settings
        self.builder = newton.ModelBuilder()
        newton.solvers.SolverMuJoCo.register_custom_attributes(self.builder)
        self.builder.default_joint_cfg = newton.ModelBuilder.JointDofConfig(
            armature=0.06,
            limit_ke=1.0e3,
            limit_kd=1.0e1,
        )
        self.builder.default_shape_cfg.ke = 5.0e4
        self.builder.default_shape_cfg.kd = 5.0e2
        self.builder.default_shape_cfg.kf = 1.0e3
        self.builder.default_shape_cfg.mu = 0.75

        # Load robot URDF
        asset_dir = newton.utils.download_asset("anybotics_anymal_c")
        urdf_path = str(asset_dir / "urdf" / "anymal.urdf")
        self.builder.add_urdf(
            urdf_path,
            xform=wp.transform(wp.vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.62), wp.quat_from_axis_angle(wp.vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), wp.pi * 0.5)),
            floating=True,
            enable_self_collisions=False,
            collapse_fixed_joints=True,
            ignore_inertial_definitions=False,
        )

        # Enlarge foot collision spheres for stability on uneven terrain
        for i in range(len(self.builder.shape_type)):
            if self.builder.shape_type[i] == GeoType.SPHERE:
                radius = self.builder.shape_scale[i][0]
                self.builder.shape_scale[i] = (radius * 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)

        # Generate procedural terrain only when not testing
        if not self.testing_mode:
            terrain_mesh = newton.Mesh.create_terrain(
                grid_size=(8, 3),
                block_size=(3.0, 3.0),
                terrain_types=["random_grid", "flat", "wave", "gap", "pyramid_stairs"],
                terrain_params={
                    "pyramid_stairs": {"step_width": 0.3, "step_height": 0.02, "platform_width": 0.6},
                    "random_grid": {"grid_width": 0.3, "grid_height_range": (0, 0.02)},
                    "wave": {"wave_amplitude": 0.1, "wave_frequency": 2.0},
                },
                seed=42,
                compute_inertia=False,
            )
            terrain_offset = wp.transform(p=wp.vec3(-5, -2.0, 0.01), q=wp.quat_identity())
            self.builder.add_shape_mesh(
                body=-1,
                mesh=terrain_mesh,
                xform=terrain_offset,
                cfg=newton.ModelBuilder.ShapeConfig(has_shape_collision=False),
            )

        self.builder.add_ground_plane()

        # Simulation parameters
        self.sim_time = 0.0
        self.step_counter = 0
        fps = 50
        self.frame_interval = 1.0 / fps
        self.substeps_per_frame = 4
        self.dt_per_step = self.frame_interval / self.substeps_per_frame

        # Set initial joint angles
        init_joint_angles = {
            "RH_HAA": 0.0,
            "RH_HFE": -0.4,
            "RH_KFE": 0.8,
            "LH_HAA": 0.0,
            "LH_HFE": -0.4,
            "LH_KFE": 0.8,
            "RF_HAA": 0.0,
            "RF_HFE": 0.4,
            "RF_KFE": -0.8,
            "LF_HAA": 0.0,
            "LF_HFE": 0.4,
            "LF_KFE": -0.8,
        }

        # Map named joints to indices in joint_q array
        for name, angle in init_joint_angles.items():
            idx = next(
                (i for i, label in enumerate(self.builder.joint_label) if label.endswith(f"/{name}")),
                None,
            )
            if idx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Joint '{name}' missing from model definition.")
            self.builder.joint_q[idx + 6] = angle

        # Configure PD gains for joint control
        for i in range(len(self.builder.joint_target_ke)):
            self.builder.joint_target_ke[i] = 150
            self.builder.joint_target_kd[i] = 5

        # Finalize model and configure solver
        self.model = self.builder.finalize()
        use_mujoco_contacts = getattr(config_args, "use_mujoco_contacts", False)
        self.solver = newton.solvers.SolverMuJoCo(
            self.model,
            use_mujoco_contacts=use_mujoco_contacts,
            solver="newton",
            ls_parallel=False,
            ls_iterations=50,
            njmax=50,
            nconmax=100,
        )
        self.visualizer.set_model(self.model)

        # Camera tracking toggle
        self.camera_tracking = True
        if isinstance(self.visualizer, newton.viewer.ViewerGL):
            def ui_callback(imgui):
                changed, enabled = imgui.checkbox("Follow Camera", self.camera_tracking)
                if changed:
                    self.camera_tracking = enabled
            self.visualizer.register_ui_callback(ui_callback, position="side")

        # Initialize simulation states
        self.state_a = self.model.state()
        self.state_b = self.model.state()
        self.control_input = self.model.control()

        # Precompute FK to update body poses
        newton.eval_fk(self.model, self.state_a.joint_q, self.state_a.joint_qd, self.state_a)

        # Contact handling setup
        self.contact_data = None if use_mujoco_contacts else self.model.contacts()

        # Load RL policy
        policy_dir = newton.utils.download_asset("anybotics_anymal_c")
        policy_file = str(policy_dir / "rl_policies" / "anymal_walking_policy_physx.pt")
        self.policy_net = torch.jit.load(policy_file, map_location=self.torch_backend)

        # Store reference joint positions for normalization
        self.ref_joint_pos = torch.tensor(
            self.state_a.joint_q[7:], device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)

        # Predefined tensors for simulation
        self.action_tensor = torch.zeros(1, 12, device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.reordered_action = torch.zeros(1, 12, device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.lab_to_mujoco_indices = torch.tensor(LAB_TO_MUJOCO, device=self.torch_backend)
        self.mujoco_to_lab_indices = torch.tensor(MUJOCO_TO_LAB, device=self.torch_backend)
        self.gravity_vector = torch.tensor([[0.0, 0.0, -1.0]], device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.command_vector = torch.zeros((1, 3), device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.command_vector[0, 0] = 1.0

        # Prepare capture graph for CUDA execution
        self.capture_graph()

    def capture_graph(self):
        if self.device.is_cuda:
            temp_tensor = torch.zeros(18, device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32)
            self.control_input.joint_target_pos = wp.from_torch(temp_tensor, dtype=wp.float32, requires_grad=False)
            with wp.ScopedCapture() as captured_graph:
                self.run_simulation_step()
            self.compiled_graph = captured_graph.graph
        else:
            self.compiled_graph = None

    def run_simulation_step(self):
        for _ in range(self.substeps_per_frame):
            self.state_a.clear_forces()
            self.visualizer.apply_forces(self.state_a)
            if self.contact_data is not None:
                self.model.collide(self.state_a, self.contact_data)
            self.solver.step(self.state_a, self.state_b, self.control_input, self.contact_data, self.dt_per_step)
            self.state_a, self.state_b = self.state_b, self.state_a

    def advance(self):
        # Construct observation tensor
        observation = build_observation(
            self.action_tensor,
            self.state_a,
            self.ref_joint_pos,
            self.torch_backend,
            self.lab_to_mujoco_indices,
            self.gravity_vector,
            self.command_vector,
        )

        # Run policy inference
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.action_tensor = self.policy_net(observation)
            self.reordered_action = torch.gather(self.action_tensor, 1, self.mujoco_to_lab_indices.unsqueeze(0))
            target_positions = self.ref_joint_pos + 0.5 * self.reordered_action
            full_control = torch.cat([torch.zeros(6, device=self.torch_backend, dtype=torch.float32), target_positions.squeeze(0)])
            control_wp = wp.from_torch(full_control, dtype=wp.float32, requires_grad=False)
            wp.copy(self.control_input.joint_target_pos, control_wp)

        # Execute simulation step using graph or fallback
        if self.compiled_graph:
            wp.capture_launch(self.compiled_graph)
        else:
            self.run_simulation_step()

        self.sim_time += self.frame_interval

    def render_frame(self):
        if self.camera_tracking:
            pos = wp.vec3(*self.state_a.joint_q.numpy()[:3]) + wp.vec3(10.0, 0.0, 2.0)
            self.visualizer.set_camera(pos=pos, pitch=0.0, yaw=-180.0)

        self.visualizer.begin_frame(self.sim_time)
        self.visualizer.log_state(self.state_a)
        self.visualizer.end_frame()

    def validate_results(self):
        # Verify body and joint naming conventions
        body_labels = [lbl.split("/")[-1] for lbl in self.model.body_label]
        assert body_labels == [
            "base",
            "LF_HIP",
            "LF_THIGH",
            "LF_SHANK",
            "RF_HIP",
            "RF_THIGH",
            "RF_SHANK",
            "LH_HIP",
            "LH_THIGH",
            "LH_SHANK",
            "RH_HIP",
            "RH_THIGH",
            "RH_SHANK",
        ]

        joint_labels = [lbl.split("/")[-1] for lbl in self.model.joint_label]
        assert joint_labels == [
            "floating_base",
            "LF_HAA",
            "LF_HFE",
            "LF_KFE",
            "RF_HAA",
            "RF_HFE",
            "RF_KFE",
            "LH_HAA",
            "LH_HFE",
            "LH_KFE",
            "RH_HAA",
            "RH_HFE",
            "RH_KFE",
        ]

        # Validate physical constraints
        newton.examples.test_body_state(
            self.model,
            self.state_a,
            "all bodies are above the ground",
            lambda q, qd: q[2] > 0.1,
        )
        newton.examples.test_body_state(
            self.model,
            self.state_a,
            "the robot went in the right direction",
            lambda q, qd: q[1] > 9.0,
        )
        forward_limits_min = wp.spatial_vector(-0.5, 0.9, -0.2, -0.8, -1.5, -0.5)
        forward_limits_max = wp.spatial_vector(0.5, 1.1, 0.2, 0.8, 1.5, 0.5)
        newton.examples.test_body_state(
            self.model,
            self.state_a,
            "the robot is moving forward and not falling",
            lambda q, qd: newton.math.vec_inside_limits(qd, forward_limits_min, forward_limits_max),
            indices=[0],
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    viewer, args = newton.examples.init()
    scenario = SimulationScenario(viewer, args)
    newton.examples.run(scenario, args)

import io
import json
import os
from collections import deque
from typing import Optional, Union
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from omegaconf import OmegaConf

# OpenSora imports
from opensora.registry import MODELS, SCHEDULERS, build_module
from opensora.utils.inference_utils import prepare_multi_resolution_info
from opensora.utils.misc import to_torch_dtype

from rlinf.data.datasets.world_model import NpyTrajectoryDatasetWrapper
from rlinf.envs.utils import recursive_to_device
from rlinf.envs.world_model.base_world_env import BaseWorldEnv

__all__ = ["OpenSoraEnv"]

class OpenSoraEnv(BaseWorldEnv):
    def __init__(
        self,
        cfg,
        num_envs,
        seed_offset,
        total_num_processes,
        worker_info,
        record_metrics=True,
    ):
        super().__init__(cfg, num_envs, seed_offset, total_num_processes, worker_info, record_metrics)
        
        # World model config
        wm_cfg = self.cfg.world_model_cfg
        self.dtype = to_torch_dtype(wm_cfg.get("dtype", "bf16"))
        
        # Enable TF32 for performance
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
        torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True
        
        # Reset state management
        self.use_fixed_reset_state_ids = cfg.use_fixed_reset_state_ids
        self.group_size = cfg.group_size
        self.num_groups = self.num_envs // self.group_size
        
        # Initialize RNG state
        self._rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=self.seed)
        
        # Update reset state IDs
        self.update_reset_state_ids()
        
        # Model hyperparameters
        self.chunk = wm_cfg.chunk  # Ta
        self.condition_frames = wm_cfg.condition_frame_length  # To
        self.total_frames = self.chunk + self.condition_frames
        self.img_size = tuple(wm_cfg.image_size)
        
        # Load models
        self.vae = self._load_vae().eval().to(self.device, self.dtype)
        self.model = self._load_model().eval().to(self.device, self.dtype)
        self.scheduler = self._load_scheduler()
        
        # Reward model
        self.reward_model = self._load_reward_model().eval().to(self.device)
        
        # VAE type detection
        vae_type = wm_cfg.vae.get("type", "OpenSoraVAE_V1_2")
        self.is_vae_v1_2 = vae_type == "OpenSoraVAE_V1_2"
        self.z_mask_frames = int(self.chunk / 4 if self.is_vae_v1_2 else self.chunk)
        self.z_cond_len = int(self.condition_frames / 4 if self.is_vae_v1_2 else self.condition_frames)
        
        # State initialization
        self.current_obs = None
        self.task_descriptions = [""] * self.num_envs
        self.init_ee_poses = [None] * self.num_envs
        
        # Latent frame queue per environment
        self.latent_queue = [
            deque(maxlen=self.z_cond_len) for _ in range(self.num_envs)
        ]
        
        # Action normalization stats
        self.action_stats = self._load_action_stats()
        
        # Preprocessing pipelines
        self.resize_transform = transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize(self.img_size)])
        self.norm_transform = transforms.Compose([
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5], std=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5], inplace=True),
        ])
        
        # Inference parameters
        self.fps = wm_cfg.get("fps", 3.0)
        self.multi_res = wm_cfg.get("multi_resolution", "STDiT2")
        
        # Multi-resolution info
        self.model_args = prepare_multi_resolution_info(
            self.multi_res, 1, self.img_size, self.total_frames, self.fps, self.device, self.dtype
        )
        
        self._is_offloaded = False

    def _build_dataset(self, cfg):
        return NpyTrajectoryDatasetWrapper(cfg.initial_image_path)

    def _load_vae(self):
        vae_cfg = OmegaConf.to_container(self.cfg.world_model_cfg.vae, resolve=True)
        return build_module(vae_cfg, MODELS)

    def _load_model(self):
        input_shape = (self.total_frames, *self.img_size)
        latent_shape = self.vae.get_latent_size(input_shape)
        model_cfg = OmegaConf.to_container(self.cfg.world_model_cfg.model, resolve=True)
        return build_module(
            model_cfg,
            MODELS,
            input_size=latent_shape,
            in_channels=self.vae.out_channels,
            enable_sequence_parallelism=False,
        )

    def _load_scheduler(self):
        scheduler_cfg = OmegaConf.to_container(self.cfg.world_model_cfg.scheduler, resolve=True)
        return build_module(scheduler_cfg, SCHEDULERS)

    def _load_reward_model(self):
        rm_cfg = OmegaConf.to_container(self.cfg.world_model_cfg.reward_model, resolve=True)
        return build_module(rm_cfg, MODELS)

    def _load_action_stats(self):
        stats_path = self.cfg.world_model_cfg.get("stats_path", None)
        if stats_path and os.path.exists(stats_path):
            with open(stats_path, "r") as f:
                stats = json.load(f)
                q01 = np.array(stats["action"]["q01"], dtype=np.float32)
                q99 = np.array(stats["action"]["q99"], dtype=np.float32)
            return {"q01": q01, "q99": q99}
        raise ValueError(f"Action stats path {stats_path} does not exist")

    def get_state(self) -> bytes:
        env_state = {
            "current_obs": recursive_to_device(self.current_obs, "cpu") if self.current_obs is not None else None,
            "task_descriptions": self.task_descriptions,
            "init_ee_poses": self.init_ee_poses,
            "elapsed_steps": self.elapsed_steps,
            "prev_step_reward": self.prev_step_reward.cpu(),
            "_is_start": self._is_start,
            "reset_state_ids": self.reset_state_ids.cpu(),
            "rng_state": self._rng.bit_generator.state,
        }
        if self.record_metrics:
            env_state.update({
                "success_once": self.success_once.cpu(),
                "returns": self.returns.cpu(),
            })
        
        latent_queues_cpu = []
        for q in self.latent_queue:
            latent_queues_cpu.append([recursive_to_device(f, "cpu") for f in q])
        env_state["latent_queue"] = latent_queues_cpu
        
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        torch.save(env_state, buffer)
        return buffer.getvalue()

    def load_state(self, state_buffer: bytes):
        buffer = io.BytesIO(state_buffer)
        state = torch.load(buffer, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        
        self.current_obs = (
            recursive_to_device(state["current_obs"], self.device)
            if state["current_obs"] is not None else None
        )
        self.task_descriptions = state["task_descriptions"]
        self.init_ee_poses = state["init_ee_poses"]
        self.elapsed_steps = state["elapsed_steps"]
        self.prev_step_reward = state["prev_step_reward"].to(self.device)
        self._is_start = state["_is_start"]
        self.reset_state_ids = state["reset_state_ids"].to(self.device)
        self._rng.bit_generator.state = state["rng_state"]
        
        latent_queues_state = state["latent_queue"]
        for i in range(self.num_envs):
            self.latent_queue[i].clear()
            for frame in latent_queues_state[i]:
                self.latent_queue[i].append(recursive_to_device(frame, self.device))
        
        if self.record_metrics and "success_once" in state:
            self.success_once = state["success_once"].to(self.device)
            self.returns = state["returns"].to(self.device)

    def offload(self):
        if self._is_offloaded:
            return
        self.vae = self.vae.to("cpu")
        self.model = self.model.to("cpu")
        self.reward_model = self.reward_model.to("cpu")
        self.current_obs = recursive_to_device(self.current_obs, "cpu")
        self.prev_step_reward = self.prev_step_reward.cpu()
        self.reset_state_ids = self.reset_state_ids.cpu()
        if self.record_metrics:
            self.success_once = self.success_once.cpu()
            self.returns = self.returns.cpu()
        for i in range(self.num_envs):
            self.latent_queue[i] = deque(
                [recursive_to_device(f, "cpu") for f in self.latent_queue[i]],
                maxlen=self.z_cond_len,
            )
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        self._is_offloaded = True

    def onload(self):
        if not self._is_offloaded:
            return
        self.vae = self.vae.to(self.device, self.dtype)
        self.model = self.model.to(self.device, self.dtype)
        self.reward_model = self.reward_model.to(self.device)
        self.current_obs = recursive_to_device(self.current_obs, self.device)
        self.prev_step_reward = self.prev_step_reward.to(self.device)
        self.reset_state_ids = self.reset_state_ids.to(self.device)
        if self.record_metrics:
            self.success_once = self.success_once.to(self.device)
            self.returns = self.returns.to(self.device)
        for i in range(self.num_envs):
            self.latent_queue[i] = deque(
                [recursive_to_device(f, self.device) for f in self.latent_queue[i]],
                maxlen=self.z_cond_len,
            )
        self._is_offloaded = False

    def _normalize_actions(self, actions):
        if self.action_stats is not None:
            q01 = self.action_stats["q01"]
            q99 = self.action_stats["q99"]
            actions = 2 * ((actions - q01) / (q99 - q01)) - 1
        return actions

    def _init_metrics(self):
        self.success_once = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, device=self.device, dtype=torch.bool)
        self.returns = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)

    def _reset_metrics(self, env_idx=None):
        if env_idx is not None:
            mask = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, dtype=bool, device=self.device)
            mask[env_idx] = True
            self.prev_step_reward[mask] = 0.0
            if self.record_metrics:
                self.success_once[mask] = False
                self.returns[mask] = 0
        else:
            self.prev_step_reward[:] = 0
            if self.record_metrics:
                self.success_once[:] = False
                self.returns[:] = 0.0
            self._elapsed_steps = 0

    def _record_metrics(self, step_reward, terminations, infos):
        episode_info = {}
        self.returns += step_reward
        if isinstance(terminations, torch.Tensor):
            self.success_once |= terminations
        else:
            self.success_once |= torch.tensor(terminations, device=self.device, dtype=torch.bool)
        episode_info["success_once"] = self.success_once.clone()
        episode_info["return"] = self.returns.clone()
        episode_info["episode_len"] = torch.full((self.num_envs,), self.elapsed_steps, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
        episode_info["reward"] = episode_info["return"] / episode_info["episode_len"]
        infos["episode"] = episode_info
        return infos

    def _compute_chunk_rewards(self, chunk_rewards):
        reward_diffs = torch.zeros((self.num_envs, self.chunk), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
        for i in range(self.chunk):
            reward_diffs[:, i] = (self.cfg.reward_coef * chunk_rewards[:, i] - self.prev_step_reward)
            self.prev_step_reward = self.cfg.reward_coef * chunk_rewards[:, i]
        return reward_diffs if self.use_rel_reward else chunk_rewards

    def _estimate_success(self, chunk_rewards):
        threshold = getattr(self.cfg, "success_reward_threshold", 0.9)
        max_rewards = torch.amax(chunk_rewards, dim=1)
        success_est = max_rewards >= threshold
        return success_est.to(self.device)

    def update_reset_state_ids(self):
        total_episodes = len(self.dataset)
        indices = self._rng.integers(low=0, high=total_episodes, size=(self.num_groups,))
        self.reset_state_ids = torch.from_numpy(np.repeat(indices, self.group_size)).to(self.device)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def reset(
        self,
        *,
        seed: Optional[Union[int, list[int]]] = None,
        options: Optional[dict] = {},
        episode_indices: Optional[Union[np.ndarray, torch.Tensor]] = None,
    ):
        self.onload()
        self.elapsed_steps = 0
        
        if self._is_start:
            if self.use_fixed_reset_state_ids:
                episode_indices = self.reset_state_ids
            self._is_start = False
        
        num_envs = self.num_envs
        if len(self.dataset) < num_envs:
            raise ValueError(f"Not enough episodes in dataset. Found {len(self.dataset)}, need {num_envs}")
        
        if episode_indices is None:
            if seed is not None:
                if isinstance(seed, list):
                    self._rng = np.random.default_rng(seed[0])
                else:
                    self._rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
            episode_indices = self._rng.choice(len(self.dataset), size=num_envs, replace=False)
        else:
            if isinstance(episode_indices, torch.Tensor):
                episode_indices = episode_indices.cpu().numpy()
        
        img_tensors = []
        task_descs = []
        init_poses = []
        
        for env_idx, ep_idx in enumerate(episode_indices):
            ep_data = self.dataset[ep_idx]
            if not ep_data["start_items"]:
                raise ValueError(f"Empty start_items for episode {ep_idx}")
            first_frame = ep_data["start_items"][0]
            
            task_desc = ep_data.get("task", "")
            task_descs.append(str(task_desc))
            
            if "image" not in first_frame:
                raise ValueError(f"No 'image' key in frame for episode {ep_idx}")
            img_tensor = first_frame["image"]
            
            if "observation.state" in first_frame:
                init_poses.append(first_frame["observation.state"].numpy())
            else:
                init_poses.append(None)
            
            if img_tensor.shape[1:] != self.img_size:
                img_tensor = img_tensor.unsqueeze(0)
                img_tensor = F.interpolate(img_tensor, size=self.img_size, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
                img_tensor = img_tensor.squeeze(0)
            
            img_tensor = self.norm_transform(img_tensor)
            img_tensor = img_tensor.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, self.condition_frames, 1, 1)
            img_tensors.append(img_tensor)
        
        stacked_imgs = torch.stack(img_tensors, dim=0).to(self.device)
        self.current_obs = stacked_imgs.unsqueeze(2).to(self.device)
        
        images_for_encode = self.current_obs
        b, c, v, t, h, w = images_for_encode.shape
        images_flat = images_for_encode.permute(0, 3, 1, 2, 4, 5).reshape(b * t, c, h, w)
        images_flat = images_flat.to(self.device).to(self.dtype)
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            z_encoded = self.vae.encode(images_flat.unsqueeze(2)).squeeze(2)
        
        z_encoded = z_encoded.reshape(b, t, *z_encoded.shape[1:]).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        
        for env_idx in range(num_envs):
            self.latent_queue[env_idx].clear()
            for t_idx in range(t):
                frame_latent = z_encoded[env_idx:env_idx+1, :, t_idx:t_idx+1, :, :]
                self.latent_queue[env_idx].append(frame_latent)
        
        self._is_start = False
        self._reset_metrics()
        
        action_dim = getattr(self.cfg, "action_dim", 7)
        init_actions = []
        for pose in init_poses:
            if pose is not None:
                act = pose.flatten()
                if len(act) < action_dim:
                    act = np.pad(act, (0, action_dim - len(act)))
                elif len(act) > action_dim:
                    act = act[:action_dim]
            else:
                act = np.zeros(action_dim, dtype=np.float32)
            init_actions.append(act)
        
        self.task_descriptions = task_descs
        self.init_ee_poses = init_actions
        
        obs = self._wrap_obs()
        return obs, {}

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, actions=None, auto_reset=True):
        raise NotImplementedError("step in OpenSora Env is not implemented; use chunk_step instead")

    def _predict_next_rewards(self):
        if self.reward_model is None:
            raise ValueError("Reward model is not loaded")
        
        b, c, v, t, h, w = self.current_obs.shape
        extract_obs = self.current_obs.permute(0, 3, 1, 2, 4, 5)
        
        if self.cfg.world_model_cfg.reward_model.type == "ResnetRM":
            extract_obs = extract_obs[:, -self.chunk:, :, :, :, :].reshape(b * self.chunk, 3, v, h, w).squeeze(2)
            extract_obs = extract_obs.to(self.device)
            rewards = self.reward_model.predict_rew(extract_obs).reshape(b, self.chunk)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown reward model type: {self.cfg.world_model_cfg.reward_model.type}")
        return rewards

    def _predict_next_frames(self, actions):
        num_envs = self.num_envs
        assert actions.shape[0] == num_envs, f"Actions shape mismatch: {actions.shape} vs {num_envs}"
        
        actions_np = actions if isinstance(actions, np.ndarray) else actions.cpu().numpy()
        actions_norm = self._normalize_actions(actions_np)
        actions_tensor = torch.from_numpy(actions_norm).to(self.device).to(self.dtype)
        
        latent_shape = self.vae.get_latent_size((self.total_frames, *self.img_size))
        
        cond_frames_list = []
        for env_idx in range(num_envs):
            cond = torch.cat(list(self.latent_queue[env_idx]), dim=2).squeeze(0)
            cond_frames_list.append(cond)
        cond_batch = torch.stack(cond_frames_list, dim=0)
        
        act_batch = actions_tensor.reshape(num_envs, -1, actions_tensor.shape[-1])
        
        noise = torch.randn(
            num_envs,
            self.vae.out_channels,
            self.z_mask_frames,
            *latent_shape[1:],
            device=self.device,
            dtype=self.dtype,
        )
        
        full_latents = torch.cat([cond_batch, noise], dim=2)
        masks = torch.tensor(
            [[0] * self.z_cond_len + [1] * self.z_mask_frames] * num_envs,
            device=self.device,
            dtype=self.dtype,
        )
        
        y = act_batch.to(self.device).to(self.dtype)
        
        with torch.amp.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=self.dtype):
            samples = self.scheduler.sample(
                self.model,
                z=full_latents,
                y=y,
                device=self.device,
                additional_args=self.model_args,
                progress=False,
                mask=masks,
            )
        
        pred_latents = samples[:, :, -self.z_mask_frames:, :, :].to(self.dtype)
        
        for env_idx in range(num_envs):
            env_pred = pred_latents[env_idx:env_idx+1]
            chunks = env_pred.chunk(self.z_mask_frames if self.is_vae_v1_2 else self.chunk, dim=2)
            for ch in chunks:
                self.latent_queue[env_idx].append(ch)
        
        decode_args = {"num_frames": 12} if self.is_vae_v1_2 else {}
        pred_images = self.vae.decode(pred_latents, **decode_args)
        
        x_samples = pred_images.unsqueeze(2)
        
        if self.current_obs.shape[3] == self.condition_frames:
            self.current_obs = torch.cat([self.current_obs, x_samples], dim=3)
        else:
            self.current_obs = torch.cat([self.current_obs, x_samples], dim=3)
        
        max_frames = self.condition_frames + self.chunk * 2
        if self.current_obs.shape[3] > max_frames:
            self.current_obs = self.current_obs[:, :, :, -max_frames:, :, :]

    def _format_observation(self):
        b, c, v, t, h, w = self.current_obs.shape
        last_frame = self.current_obs[:, :, 0, -1, :, :]
        full_img = last_frame.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        full_img = (full_img + 1.0) / 2.0 * 255.0
        full_img = torch.clamp(full_img, 0, 255).to(torch.uint8)
        
        if full_img.shape[1:3] != self.img_size:
            full_img = full_img.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
            full_img = F.interpolate(full_img, size=self.img_size, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
            full_img = full_img.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        
        states = torch.zeros((b, 16), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        task_descs = getattr(self, "task_descriptions", [""] * b)
        
        return {
            "main_images": full_img,
            "wrist_images": None,
            "states": states,
            "task_descriptions": task_descs,
        }

    def _auto_reset(self, dones, extracted_obs, infos):
        final_obs = extracted_obs
        final_info = infos
        new_obs, new_infos = self.reset()
        new_infos["final_observation"] = final_obs
        new_infos["final_info"] = final_info
        new_infos["_final_info"] = dones
        new_infos["_final_observation"] = dones
        new_infos["_elapsed_steps"] = dones
        return new_obs, new_infos

    @torch.no_grad()
    def chunk_step(self, policy_output_action):
        self.onload()
        
        with torch.amp.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=self.dtype):
            self._predict_next_frames(policy_output_action)
        
        self.elapsed_steps += self.chunk
        obs = self._format_observation()
        obs_list = [obs]
        
        chunk_rewards = self._predict_next_rewards()
        reward_tensors = self._compute_chunk_rewards(chunk_rewards)
        success_est = self._estimate_success(chunk_rewards)
        
        raw_term = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, self.chunk, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device)
        raw_term[:, -1] = success_est
        raw_trunc = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, self.chunk, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device)
        
        truncation = torch.tensor(self.elapsed_steps >= self.cfg.max_episode_steps, device=self.device)
        if truncation.any():
            raw_trunc[:, -1] = truncation
        
        past_dones = torch.logical_or(raw_term.any(dim=1), raw_trunc.any(dim=1))
        
        if past_dones.any() and self.auto_reset:
            obs_list[-1], infos = self._auto_reset(past_dones, obs_list[-1], {})
        else:
            infos = {}
        
        infos = self._record_metrics(reward_tensors.sum(dim=1), raw_term[:, -1], infos)
        
        term_out = torch.zeros_like(raw_term)
        term_out[:, -1] = raw_term[:, -1]
        trunc_out = torch.zeros_like(raw_trunc)
        trunc_out[:, -1] = raw_trunc[:, -1]
        
        return obs_list, reward_tensors, term_out, trunc_out, [infos]

from __future__ import annotations

def _append_list(destination: list[int], source: list[int]) -> None:
    # Using extend instead of manual loop
    destination.extend(source)

def _to_little_endian_16(value: int) -> list[int]:
    # Bit manipulation with different order
    low_byte = value & 0xFF
    high_byte = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
    return [low_byte, high_byte]

def _compress_lzw(image_data: bytes, base_code_size: int = 8) -> bytes:
    if not image_data:
        return b''
    
    clear_marker = 1 << base_code_size
    end_marker = clear_marker + 1
    
    current_code_bits = base_code_size + 1
    output_bytes: list[int] = []
    bit_storage = 0
    bit_accumulator = 0
    
    # Insert clear code at beginning
    bit_storage |= clear_marker << bit_accumulator
    bit_accumulator += current_code_bits
    
    # Flush bits to output
    while bit_accumulator >= 8:
        output_bytes.append(bit_storage & 0xFF)
        bit_storage >>= 8
        bit_accumulator -= 8
    
    # Process each pixel
    for pixel_value in image_data:
        bit_storage |= pixel_value << bit_accumulator
        bit_accumulator += current_code_bits
        
        while bit_accumulator >= 8:
            output_bytes.append(bit_storage & 0xFF)
            bit_storage >>= 8
            bit_accumulator -= 8
        
        # Insert clear code after each byte
        bit_storage |= clear_marker << bit_accumulator
        bit_accumulator += current_code_bits
        
        while bit_accumulator >= 8:
            output_bytes.append(bit_storage & 0xFF)
            bit_storage >>= 8
            bit_accumulator -= 8
        
        # Reset code size (simplified version)
        current_code_bits = base_code_size + 1
    
    # Add end marker
    bit_storage |= end_marker << bit_accumulator
    bit_accumulator += current_code_bits
    
    while bit_accumulator >= 8:
        output_bytes.append(bit_storage & 0xFF)
        bit_storage >>= 8
        bit_accumulator -= 8
    
    # Handle remaining bits
    if bit_accumulator > 0:
        output_bytes.append(bit_storage & 0xFF)
    
    return bytes(output_bytes)

def _create_grayscale_colors() -> bytes:
    # Generate palette using list comprehension
    palette = []
    for gray in range(256):
        palette.extend([gray, gray, gray])
    return bytes(palette)

def write_gif(
    filename: str,
    img_width: int,
    img_height: int,
    frame_sequence: list[bytes],
    color_table: bytes,
    frame_delay: int = 4,
    repeat_count: int = 0,
) -> None:
    # Validate palette size
    if len(color_table) != 768:  # 256 * 3
        raise ValueError("palette must contain exactly 768 bytes")
    
    # Convert frames to lists of integers
    processed_frames: list[list[int]] = []
    for frame in frame_sequence:
        frame_values = [b for b in frame]
        if len(frame_values) != img_width * img_height:
            raise ValueError(f"frame dimensions mismatch: expected {img_width * img_height} pixels")
        processed_frames.append(frame_values)
    
    # Convert palette to integer list
    color_list = [c for c in color_table]
    
    # Build GIF file
    gif_data: list[int] = []
    
    # GIF header "GIF89a"
    gif_data.extend([71, 73, 70, 56, 57, 97])
    
    # Screen descriptor
    gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(img_width))
    gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(img_height))
    gif_data.append(0xF7)  # Global color table flag + resolution
    gif_data.append(0)     # Background color index
    gif_data.append(0)     # Pixel aspect ratio
    
    # Global color table
    gif_data.extend(color_list)
    
    # Netscape application extension for looping
    gif_data.extend([0x21, 0xFF, 0x0B, 78, 69, 84, 83, 67, 65, 80, 69, 50, 46, 48, 0x03, 0x01])
    gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(repeat_count))
    gif_data.append(0)
    
    # Write each frame
    for frame_pixels in processed_frames:
        # Graphic control extension
        gif_data.extend([0x21, 0xF9, 0x04, 0x00])
        gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(frame_delay))
        gif_data.extend([0x00, 0x00])
        
        # Image descriptor
        gif_data.append(0x2C)
        gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(0))  # Left position
        gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(0))  # Top position
        gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(img_width))
        gif_data.extend(_to_little_endian_16(img_height))
        gif_data.append(0)  # Local color table flag
        gif_data.append(8)  # LZW minimum code size
        
        # Compressed image data
        compressed_data = _compress_lzw(bytes(frame_pixels), 8)
        
        # Write data sub-blocks
        offset = 0
        while offset < len(compressed_data):
            chunk_size = min(255, len(compressed_data) - offset)
            gif_data.append(chunk_size)
            for i in range(chunk_size):
                gif_data.append(compressed_data[offset + i])
            offset += chunk_size
        
        gif_data.append(0)  # End of image marker
    
    gif_data.append(0x3B)  # GIF trailer
    
    # Write to file
    with open(filename, 'wb') as file:
        file.write(bytes(gif_data))

def format_for_claude(data):
    """Optimized formatting for Claude model consumption"""
    if "error" in data:
        return f"Error: {data['error']}"

    lines = []
    
    # Determine section header based on search type
    if "stack" in data and data["stack"]:
        lines.append("## UI Pro Max Stack Guidelines")
        lines.append(f"**Stack:** {data['stack']} | **Query:** {data['query']}")
    else:
        lines.append("## UI Pro Max Search Results")
        lines.append(f"**Domain:** {data['domain']} | **Query:** {data['query']}")
    
    lines.append(f"**Source:** {data['file']} | **Found:** {data['count']} results\n")

    # Process each result item
    for idx, item in enumerate(data['results'], start=1):
        lines.append(f"### Result {idx}")
        for field, content in item.items():
            text = str(content)
            if len(text) > 300:
                text = text[:300] + "..."
            lines.append(f"- **{field}:** {text}")
        lines.append("")

    return "\n".join(lines)

def by_length(arr):
    """
    Given an array of integers, filter out numbers not in range 1-9,
    sort the remaining numbers in ascending order, reverse the list,
    and convert each number to its English word representation.
    
    Example:
      arr = [2, 1, 1, 4, 5, 8, 2, 3]   
            -> filter: [2, 1, 1, 4, 5, 8, 2, 3]
            -> sort: [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8]
            -> reverse: [8, 5, 4, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1]
      return ["Eight", "Five", "Four", "Three", "Two", "Two", "One", "One"]
    """
    # Mapping from number to word (index 0 unused for easier mapping)
    number_words = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]
    
    # Filter valid numbers (between 1 and 9 inclusive)
    valid_numbers = []
    for num in arr:
        if 1 <= num <= 9:
            valid_numbers.append(num)
    
    # Sort in ascending order
    valid_numbers.sort()
    
    # Reverse to get descending order
    valid_numbers.reverse()
    
    # Convert to words using the mapping
    result = []
    for num in valid_numbers:
        result.append(number_words[num])
    
    return result

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import torch

class NoiseScheduleBase(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for diffusion noise scheduling mechanisms.
    """
    cumulative_alphas: torch.Tensor  # [T], cumulative alpha values for schedule
    
    @abstractmethod
    def apply_corruption(
        self, 
        clean_signal: torch.Tensor, 
        perturbation: torch.Tensor, 
        step_index: torch.Tensor
    ):
        """
        Implements the forward diffusion process (corruption).
        Args:
            clean_signal: original clean data tensor of shape [B, C, H, W]
            perturbation: noise tensor of shape [B, C, H, W]
            step_index: time step indices of shape [B]
        Returns:
            corrupted signal tensor of shape [B, C, H, W]
        """
        pass
    
    def reconstruct_noise_from_clean(
        self, 
        predicted_clean: torch.Tensor, 
        noisy_input: torch.Tensor, 
        current_step: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Derive noise prediction from a given clean prediction using the formula:
        noise = (xt - sqrt(alpha_t) * x0) / sqrt(beta_t)
        Reference: Eq. 11 in https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18828
        """
        # Preserve original dtype for final output
        input_dtype = predicted_clean.dtype
        
        # Promote to double precision for numerical stability
        clean_pred, noisy_data, cum_alphas = (
            val.to(torch.float64).to(predicted_clean.device) 
            for val in [predicted_clean, noisy_input, self.cumulative_alphas]
        )
        
        # Extract alpha and beta products at current timesteps
        alpha_t = cum_alphas[current_step].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        beta_t = 1 - alpha_t
        
        # Compute noise estimate
        noise_estimate = (noisy_data - torch.sqrt(alpha_t) * clean_pred) / torch.sqrt(beta_t)
        return noise_estimate.to(input_dtype)
    
    def reconstruct_clean_from_noise(
        self, 
        noise_estimate: torch.Tensor, 
        noisy_input: torch.Tensor, 
        current_step: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Reconstruct clean sample from noise prediction using:
        x0 = (xt - sqrt(beta_t) * noise) / sqrt(alpha_t)
        Reference: Eq. 11 in https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18828
        """
        # Maintain original precision in output
        input_dtype = noise_estimate.dtype
        
        # Convert to higher precision for computation
        noise_data, noisy_samples, cum_alphas = (
            val.to(torch.float64).to(noise_estimate.device) 
            for val in [noise_estimate, noisy_input, self.cumulative_alphas]
        )
        
        # Get timestep-specific alphas and betas
        alpha_t = cum_alphas[current_step].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        beta_t = 1 - alpha_t
        
        # Compute clean sample estimate
        clean_estimate = (noisy_samples - torch.sqrt(beta_t) * noise_data) / torch.sqrt(alpha_t)
        return clean_estimate.to(input_dtype)
    
    def reconstruct_clean_from_velocity(
        self, 
        velocity_estimate: torch.Tensor, 
        noisy_input: torch.Tensor, 
        current_step: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Reconstruct clean sample from velocity prediction using:
        x0 = sqrt(alpha_t) * xt - sqrt(beta_t) * v
        Based on velocity parameterization where:
        v = sqrt(alpha_t) * noise - sqrt(beta_t) * x0
        Reference: derivation details available at https://chatgpt.com/share/679fb6c8-3a30-8008-9b0e-d1ae892dac56
        """
        # Keep original dtype for final result
        input_dtype = velocity_estimate.dtype
        
        # Use extended precision for calculations
        vel_data, noisy_samples, cum_alphas = (
            val.to(torch.float64).to(velocity_estimate.device) 
            for val in [velocity_estimate, noisy_input, self.cumulative_alphas]
        )
        
        # Retrieve timestep-dependent parameters
        alpha_t = cum_alphas[current_step].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        beta_t = 1 - alpha_t
        
        # Apply velocity-based reconstruction formula
        clean_estimate = torch.sqrt(alpha_t) * noisy_samples - torch.sqrt(beta_t) * vel_data
        return clean_estimate.to(input_dtype)

class FlowMatchingScheduler:
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_inference_steps=100,
        total_training_steps=1000,
        shift_factor=3.0,
        max_sigma=1.0,
        min_sigma=0.003 / 1.002,
        invert_time_order=False,
        include_final_step=False,
        flip_sigmas=False,
    ):
        self.total_steps = total_training_steps
        self.shift = shift_factor
        self.sigma_upper = max_sigma
        self.sigma_lower = min_sigma
        self.invert_time = invert_time_order
        self.include_last = include_final_step
        self.flip_sigmas = flip_sigmas
        self.configure_time_steps(num_inference_steps)
    
    def configure_time_steps(
        self, 
        num_inference_steps=100, 
        denoising_strength=1.0, 
        is_training_mode=False
    ):
        # Determine starting sigma based on denoising strength
        start_sigma = (
            self.sigma_lower + (self.sigma_upper - self.sigma_lower) * denoising_strength
        )
        
        # Generate sigma sequence
        if self.include_last:
            sigmas = torch.linspace(start_sigma, self.sigma_lower, num_inference_steps + 1)[:-1]
        else:
            sigmas = torch.linspace(start_sigma, self.sigma_lower, num_inference_steps)
        
        # Apply optional transformations
        if self.invert_time:
            sigmas = torch.flip(sigmas, dims=[0])
        
        # Apply sigmoid-like mapping
        sigmas = self.shift * sigmas / (1 + (self.shift - 1) * sigmas)
        
        # Optional sigma inversion
        if self.flip_sigmas:
            sigmas = 1 - sigmas
        
        # Map sigmas to discrete timesteps
        self.discrete_sigmas = sigmas
        self.timesteps = sigmas * self.total_steps
        
        # Prepare training weights if needed
        if is_training_mode:
            x_vals = self.timesteps
            gaussian_weights = torch.exp(
                -2 * ((x_vals - num_inference_steps / 2) / num_inference_steps) ** 2
            )
            normalized_weights = gaussian_weights - gaussian_weights.min()
            self.training_weights = normalized_weights * (
                num_inference_steps / normalized_weights.sum()
            )
    
    def update_sample(
        self, 
        model_output: torch.Tensor, 
        current_step: torch.Tensor, 
        current_sample: torch.Tensor, 
        go_to_end: bool = False
    ):
        # Handle multi-dimensional timestep inputs
        if current_step.dim() == 2:
            current_step = current_step.flatten(0, 1)
        
        # Ensure tensors are on correct device
        self.discrete_sigmas = self.discrete_sigmas.to(model_output.device)
        self.timesteps = self.timesteps.to(model_output.device)
        
        # Find closest matching timestep index
        time_indices = torch.argmin(
            (self.timesteps.unsqueeze(0) - current_step.unsqueeze(1)).abs(), dim=1
        )
        
        # Get sigma values
        sigma_current = self.discrete_sigmas[time_indices].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        
        # Determine next sigma value
        if go_to_end or (time_indices + 1 >= len(self.timesteps)).any():
            sigma_next = 1 if (self.invert_time or self.flip_sigmas) else 0
        else:
            sigma_next = self.discrete_sigmas[time_indices + 1].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        
        # Update sample using Euler integration
        updated_sample = current_sample + model_output * (sigma_next - sigma_current)
        return updated_sample
    
    def corrupt_sample(
        self, 
        original_samples: torch.Tensor, 
        noise_samples: torch.Tensor, 
        step_indices: torch.Tensor
    ):
        """
        Applies diffusion corruption process.
        Input shapes:
            - original_samples: [B*T, C, H, W]
            - noise_samples: [B*T, C, H, W]
            - step_indices: [B*T]
        Output shape: [B*T, C, H, W]
        """
        if step_indices.dim() == 2:
            step_indices = step_indices.flatten(0, 1)
        
        # Move tensors to appropriate device
        self.discrete_sigmas = self.discrete_sigmas.to(noise_samples.device)
        self.timesteps = self.timesteps.to(noise_samples.device)
        
        # Match timesteps to indices
        time_indices = torch.argmin(
            (self.timesteps.unsqueeze(0) - step_indices.unsqueeze(1)).abs(), dim=1
        )
        
        # Interpolate between clean and noisy samples
        sigma_val = self.discrete_sigmas[time_indices].view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        corrupted = (1 - sigma_val) * original_samples + sigma_val * noise_samples
        return corrupted.type_as(noise_samples)
    
    def compute_training_target(
        self, 
        current_sample: torch.Tensor, 
        noise_tensor: torch.Tensor, 
        step_indices: torch.Tensor
    ):
        # For flow matching, target is simply noise minus current sample
        return noise_tensor - current_sample
    
    def compute_training_weight(
        self, 
        step_indices: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Compute per-timestep weighting for training loss.
        Input:
            - step_indices: [B*T]
        Output:
            - weights: [B*T] corresponding weights
        """
        if step_indices.dim() == 2:
            step_indices = step_indices.flatten(0, 1)
        
        # Ensure weights are on correct device
        self.training_weights = self.training_weights.to(step_indices.device)
        
        # Match timesteps to indices
        time_indices = torch.argmin(
            (self.timesteps.unsqueeze(1) - step_indices.unsqueeze(0)).abs(), dim=0
        )
        
        # Return corresponding weights
        return self.training_weights[time_indices]

import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch
from exchange.agent import ExchangeAgent
from exchange.errors import (
    TransportTimeoutError,
    RemoteAgentNoResponseError,
    _is_timeout_error,
    _is_no_payload_error,
)

def _create_mock_response(text="expected response"):
    # Create a mock part object with text attribute
    part = MagicMock()
    part.text = text
    
    # Create parts list with root attribute
    parts = [MagicMock()]
    parts[0].root = part
    
    # Create result object
    result = MagicMock()
    result.parts = parts
    
    # Create root object with result and error attributes
    root = MagicMock()
    root.result = result
    root.error = None
    
    # Create final response object
    response = MagicMock()
    response.root = root
    return response

def _generate_scenario_responses(scenario_name: str):
    from slim_bindings import SlimError
    
    if scenario_name == "retry_then_success":
        return [
            SlimError.SessionError("receive timeout waiting for message"),
            _create_mock_response("success_after_retry")
        ]
    elif scenario_name == "all_timeouts":
        return [SlimError.SessionError("receive timeout")] * 5
    elif scenario_name == "timeout_then_connection_failure":
        return [
            SlimError.SessionError("receive timeout"),
            ConnectionError("connection refused")
        ]
    elif scenario_name == "immediate_non_timeout":
        return [ValueError("bad request")]
    elif scenario_name == "first_try_success":
        return [_create_mock_response("successful_first_attempt")]
    elif scenario_name == "missing_payload_attribute":
        err = AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'payload'")
        err.name = "payload"
        return [err]
    elif scenario_name == "null_response":
        return [None]
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown scenario_name: {scenario_name}")

def _create_exception_for_timeout_check(scenario_name: str):
    if scenario_name == "nested_session_error":
        from slim_bindings import SlimError
        e = AttributeError("missing payload")
        e.__context__ = SlimError.SessionError("receive timeout")
        return e
    elif scenario_name == "standard_value_error":
        return ValueError("invalid input")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown scenario_name: {scenario_name}")

def _create_exception_for_payload_check(scenario_name: str):
    if scenario_name == "no_payload_field":
        e = AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'payload'")
        e.name = "payload"
        return e
    elif scenario_name == "different_attribute_issue":
        return AttributeError("'str' has no attribute 'foo'")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown scenario_name: {scenario_name}")

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "scenario_name,expected_output,expected_error_type,expected_call_count,verify_cause",
    _TEST_SCENARIOS,
)
async def test_a2a_send_message_scenarios(
    create_mock_factory,
    create_mock_client,
    scenario_name,
    expected_output,
    expected_error_type,
    expected_call_count,
    verify_cause,
):
    with patch("exchange.agent.asyncio.sleep", new_callable=AsyncMock) as mock_sleep:
        # Setup the mock client to use scenario-specific behavior
        create_mock_client.send_message = AsyncMock(side_effect=_generate_scenario_responses(scenario_name))
        create_mock_factory.create_client = AsyncMock(return_value=create_mock_client)
        
        agent = ExchangeAgent(factory=create_mock_factory)
        
        if expected_error_type is not None:
            with pytest.raises(expected_error_type) as exc_info:
                await agent.a2a_client_send_message("test")
            if verify_cause:
                assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is not None
        else:
            result = await agent.a2a_client_send_message("test")
            assert result == expected_output
        
        # Verify call count matches expectation
        assert create_mock_client.send_message.await_count == expected_call_count
        
        # For all-timeout scenario, verify exponential backoff timing
        if scenario_name == "all_timeouts":
            assert mock_sleep.await_count == 4
            sleep_delays = [mock_sleep.await_args_list[i][0][0] for i in range(4)]
            assert sleep_delays == [1, 3, 9, 27]

import requests
import json
import sys
import argparse

def fetch_compound_bioactivity():
    # Argument parsing setup
    arg_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Retrieve ChEMBL compound bioactivity data")
    arg_parser.add_argument("--compound", required=True, help="Compound identifier (name/InChIKey/SMILES)")
    arg_parser.add_argument("--target", help="Filter by specific target name")
    arg_parser.add_argument("--data_type", dest="type", choices=["assay", "mechanism"], default="assay")
    arguments = arg_parser.parse_args()
    
    # Base API endpoint
    api_base = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data"
    
    # Step 1: Search for molecule using provided compound identifier
    search_endpoint = f"{api_base}/molecule/search"
    search_params = {"q": arguments.compound, "limit": 1}
    response = requests.get(search_endpoint, params=search_params)
    
    if response.status_code != 200:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "Compound search failed", "http_status": response.status_code}))
        sys.exit(1)
    
    search_results = response.json()
    molecule_list = search_results.get("molecules", [])
    
    if not molecule_list:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "No matching compound found in ChEMBL"}))
        sys.exit(1)
    
    chembl_id = molecule_list[0]["molecule_chembl_id"]
    
    # Step 2: Handle requested data type
    if arguments.type == "assay":
        # Get assay count
        count_url = f"{api_base}/molecule/{chembl_id}/assay_count"
        count_response = requests.get(count_url)
        assay_counts = count_response.json()
        
        # Output basic count info
        print(json.dumps({"chembl_id": chembl_id, "total_assays": assay_counts.get("assay_count", 0)}))
        
        # Fetch top 10 activities ordered by standard_value descending
        activity_endpoint = f"{api_base}/molecule/{chembl_id}/activities"
        activity_params = {"limit": 10, "order_by": "-standard_value"}
        act_response = requests.get(activity_endpoint, params=activity_params)
        activities_data = act_response.json().get("activities", [])
        
        # Format activity records
        formatted_activities = []
        for activity in activities_data:
            formatted_activities.append({
                "assay_chembl_id": activity["assay_chembl_id"],
                "target_chembl_id": activity.get("target_chembl_id"),
                "activity_type": activity["activity_type"],
                "standard_value": activity.get("standard_value"),
                "standard_units": activity.get("standard_units")
            })
        
        print(json.dumps({"top_activities": formatted_activities}))
        
    elif arguments.type == "mechanism":
        mechanism_endpoint = f"{api_base}/mechanism/{chembl_id}"
        mech_response = requests.get(mechanism_endpoint)
        mechanisms_data = mech_response.json().get("mechanisms", [])
        
        # Format mechanism records

                "target_chembl_id": mechanism["target_chembl_id"],
                "mechanism_of_action": mechanism["mechanism_of_action"],
                "action_type": mechanism["action_type"]
            })
